verdict.rationale: The evidence covers only item-level sharing primitives: shared links with configurable access levels, collaborations that grant users and groups access, and a community note that outside parties can be selectively granted access. None of it documents org-level admin controls that restrict external sharing, domain allowlists, or enterprise-wide shared-link restrictions. These are adjacent per-item features, not the governance capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As an IT admin, external collaboration is governed — org-level controls over who can share outside the team, with domain allowlists or link restrictions
